description: Turmeric is a 7-9 month rhizome spice grown on raised beds or ridges, with Telangana (Nizamabad), Andhra Pradesh (Duggirala, Kadapa), Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu as the main producers. It needs heavy organic manuring, good drainage and disease-free seed rhizomes.
npk_split: Apply all P and half the K at planting, give the N in three equal splits at 40, 80 and 120 days after planting, and apply the remaining K with the second split at earthing up.

Leaf blotch.name: Leaf Blotch
Leaf blotch.description: A fungal leaf disease that appears on the lower leaves in humid weather, usually from October-November. Many small spots merge and the foliage looks reddish-brown and scorched, which reduces rhizome yield.
symptoms: Many small oval to rectangular yellow spots on both leaf surfaces
Spots arranged in rows along the veins
Spots turn dirty yellow, then dark golden-brown
Spots merge into irregular blotches and the leaf looks scorched
Leaf blotch.spread: Airborne spores from infected lower leaves and dried leaf debris spread in humid weather at moderate temperatures.
Leaf blotch.action: Remove and burn badly blotched lower leaves and spray mancozeb 75 WP 2.5 g/L, repeating after 15 days.

treatment.name: Mancozeb 75 WP
treatment.notes: Add a sticker and cover both leaf surfaces; 2-3 sprays at 15-day intervals from first spots.

treatment.name: Propiconazole 25 EC
treatment.notes: Alternate with mancozeb when the disease is spreading fast; only where the label lists your crop.

treatment.name: Seed rhizome treatment with mancozeb 75 WP
treatment.notes: Select seed rhizomes from a healthy crop, dip, and dry in shade before planting.

healthy.name: Healthy
healthy.description: The leaf shows no sign of disease, pest or nutrient problem. Keep up regular field scouting and balanced nutrition.
symptoms: No yellow spots, brown blotches or drying
Steady new leaf and tiller growth
healthy.action: Continue fortnightly scouting of the lower leaves, especially in humid weather.
